title: Payments (RevenueCat)
summary: subscriptions sold on the phone by Apple and Google through RevenueCat, settled onto the same entitlement the Stripe module already computes: a store seam the paywall renders against (mock store in mock mode, the SDK lazily loaded otherwise), a header-authed webhook that always answers 200, and a confirm endpoint where the server reads RevenueCat rather than trusting the device
postScaffold: store billing is OFF until REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY is set: the webhook answers 503, `POST /api/subscription/revenuecat/confirm` answers 503, and the phone's paywall runs against the mock store — `yarn dev`, `yarn mobile:mock` and every gate run that way on purpose

to turn the server on, set REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY (a v2 `sk_…` secret key), REVENUECAT_PROJECT_ID and REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env (the boot fails naming whichever is missing); REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET is the exact `Authorization` header value you type into the dashboard's webhook integration, and the route compares it in constant time

to turn the phone on, set EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID_KEY in apps/mobile/.env and on each EAS environment; a key starting with `test_` is RevenueCat's Test Store — the sheet opens and no money moves, which is what a simulator run wants — and the server refuses a `test_` secret key when NODE_ENV=production

react-native-purchases is a native module: Expo Go and any dev client built before this module was added have no `RNPurchases` to link. Rebuild the dev client (`yarn --cwd apps/mobile ios` / `android`, or the EAS development profile) before a real-mode paywall; mock mode never loads the SDK and needs no new binary

add "./plugins/withReactNativeAndroidRoot.cjs" to the `plugins` array in apps/mobile/app.config.js — a module cannot edit that file, and without it the Android build fails evaluating :react-native-purchases in a workspace whose react-native is hoisted to the repo root

the mobile gate puts the whole signed-in app behind the paywall. A product with a free tier moves `useAccessGate` off `mobile.gates` and calls it from the routes that are paid for — docs/payments-revenuecat.md, The gate
